cases.input: I build predictive models from personnel datasets and analyze written staff feedback with natural language processing. Alongside this data analysis, I use psychological research to design employee selection tests and evaluate whether those assessments are valid measures of job-related characteristics.
cases.rationale: DS covers models, NLP and datasets; IO covers psychological employee testing and selection.

cases.input: I develop machine learning pipelines to extract information from large datasets, compare predictive models, and visualize findings. The inputs include numerical records and unstructured text, which I process with programming languages and natural language processing techniques.
cases.rationale: Source DS definition covers programming, ML, NLP, structured/unstructured datasets and visualization; no psychology or marketing.

cases.input: I study how psychological characteristics relate to job performance, design employee assessment procedures, and evaluate selection and training programs. My recommendations help organizations improve staff development and the work environment.
cases.rationale: IO psychology covers employee testing, selection, training, development and work setting.
